column1: Functional bug: Reset App State button does not change "Remove" button back to "Add to cart" button.
column30:
h3. Technical details:

* *Browser:* Brave Browser 1.93.134; Chromium 151.0.7922.108
* *Login credentials:* username - “_standard_user”;_ password - “_secret sauce_“

h3. Bug description:

* The *Reset app state* button removes the selected items from the cart correctly, but +does not update+ visually the “Remove” button back to “Add to cart” for the individual product cards
* In the attached picture, 2 items were selected, then app state was reset. One more item was selected, resulting in 3 items appearing as selected, but only a “1” in the shopping cart badge icon.



*Steps to reproduce:* 
-> +Login+ (username - “_standard_user”;_ password - “_secret_sauce_“)

→ +Click+ “*Add to cart*” button for 2 different products

→ +Click+ the *expand-side-menu* button in the upper-right corner

→ +Click+ “*Reset App State*” button

→ +Click+ “*Add to cart*” button for a third different product



*Expected behavior:* When clicking the “Reset App State”, the “Remove” button from all previously selected items +should be replaced+ with the “*Add to cart*” button
*Actual behavior:* Items are removed from cart, but the “Remove” button is still displayed

column1: Logic bug: User can proceed to checkout with empty shopping cart
column30:
h3. Technical details:

* *Browser:* Brave Browser 1.93.134; Chromium 151.0.7922.108
* *Login credentials:* username - “_standard_user”;_ password - “_secret_sauce_“

h3. Bug description:

The user should receive a warning-message of an empty cart, when trying to go to checkout.

*Steps to reproduce:* 
-> +Login+ (username - “_standard_user”;_ password - “_secret_sauce_“)

→ +Click+ *cart icon* button

→ +Click+ “*Checkout*” button

→ +Enter+ anything in all 3 fields (e.g. First name - “validFirstName”; Last name - “validLastName”; Postal code - “1020”)

→ +Click+ “*Continue*” button to proceed

→ +Click+ “*Finish*” button

→ +Click+ “*Generate PDF order*” and save the confirmation-document

*Expected behavior:* When clicking the “Checkout” button, the user should not be allowed to proceed with an empty cart and receive a warning message (e.g. “Can’t proceed with empty basket”)
*Actual behavior:* The case of an empty cart is not covered and a user can complete a +null order+.

column1: Update the @testAccessLoggedOut() from AccessControlTest class with a @DataProvider
column30:
Rewrite the “testAccessLoggedOut” method using a *DataProvider* for PROTECTED_PAGES, instead of a for-loop over a string list.

*Reason: Fail-fast trap*

* in its current form, if the test fails for the first page, the test will stop without checking the rest of the pages
* with a data-provider, the test is executed individually for each page, highlighting if an eventual problem is related to a single page, or to the entire site.
